quote: "I was in the smoking-room all evening," he said, short as a docket. "Mrs Harrow and I argued, certainly. We argued about money and the will. But I did not go near the library after nine." His fingers found the rim of the armchair as if they needed the furniture for a witness.

He was polished enough to look like a verdict handed down — collar neat, gloves folded in his lap — and he had the kind of impatience that becomes a public virtue in a man who thinks time will put things right for him.
